name: Render Contract
description: The RenderBackend contract: the op families (RenderOp), the one error type (RenderError), surface handles (RenderSurface), the tone adjustments the adjust op takes (ToneAdjustment), the RenderBackend protocol, the blend-mode-to-family and raster-error mappings every backend shares, the SurfaceStore that holds a backend's PixelBuffers behind one lock and updates one in place, and FakeBackend, the recording test double.
